data.name: Basan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Basasanah’ meaning ripe fruit, this name symbolizes a mature and abundant life. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Anfal, verse 46, where the phrase ‘Bassanatun Mutmainah’ refers to the paradise of eternal bliss. This name carries the blessings of Allah SWT and the promise of a joyful and prosperous life for the child.
